topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the novel by accident, the bindings tight and new. My fingers trembled as I thumbed through the pages, my name etched into every line, every chapter a memory I thought only we shared. I should have asked, should have thought before I opened it. Knowing now, I can't unread what I've read, and the words weigh heavy, a secret I never meant to uncover. The silence between us grows, each word unspoken louder than the last, a chasm widening with each step I take, knowing I can't go back.
